page_title: STU 1-1 LEV | Stuttgart v Bayer Leverkusen 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Deniz Aytekin is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90+3' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
90+2' The referee signals a corner kick to Stuttgart.
90+2' Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

90' What a great chance for Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.

90' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the left post, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop the effort.
90' Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
89' A long ball forward to Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted.
88' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the left post.
87' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

87' A lofted cross from Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Josha Vagnoman.
85' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Deniz Undav is replaced by Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart).
85' The game is interrupted now, Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
84' We are about to witness a substitution. Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) is replacing Exequiel Palacios.
84' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) meets a cross inside the box, but Alexander Nubel wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
82' Stuttgart will take a corner kick.

81' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Lukas Hradecky sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post. Now Stuttgart have a corner.
81' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.

79' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
79' Half-chance! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a pass into the box, but Alexander Nubel reacts well to snuff out the attack.
77' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is coming onto the pitch as Chris Fuhrich cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Maximilian Mittelstadt.
73' The substitution is prepared. Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Victor Boniface.
73' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Alexander Nubel easily deals with the threat.
72' The ball goes out for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen can continue in their attacking effort.
71' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
69' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

69' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes behind for a corner. Stuttgart will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' 19:14 – the total goal attempt statistics.
69' The current number of shots on goal is 10:4.
67' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
66' Substitution. Silas (VfB Stuttgart) on for Enzo Millot.
65' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Amine Adli.
65' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) gets booked for the first time in this match.
64' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
61' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
60' Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
59' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but Alexander Nubel comes off his line to gather the ball.
58' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
56' Bayer Leverkusen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
52' Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.

52' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Good work from Bayer Leverkusen as they win a corner.
49' POST! Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
47' 1 - 1 Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
45+3' Some patient build-up play from Stuttgart as they look to unlock the defence.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A quickly taken corner by Stuttgart.
44' The linesman makes the right call and Bayer Leverkusen will have a corner.
42' Poor challenge! Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised for tripping and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle.
40' 1 - 0 Goal! Josha Vagnoman puts the ball on a plate for Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 1:0.
38' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Stuttgart, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
35' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
33' A shot from the edge of the box by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
32' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
31' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
30' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar.
30' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
28' Good movement by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
27' A dangerous towering header by Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
27' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) will take the corner.
26' Stuttgart work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
25' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
25' Bayer Leverkusen are ruled offside.
24' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Alexander Nubel.
23' It's a throw-in for Stuttgart.
22' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
20' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
17' The corner is swung in but Stuttgart can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
17' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Lukas Hradecky pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
15' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
14' An attempted cross from Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared.
13' The ball has crossed the sideline. Stuttgart are taking a throw-in.
9' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the left post and flies out of play.
8' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
7' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal despite being in a difficult position, but his shot is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
6' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Stuttgart.
3' A corner kick by Stuttgart is thwarted by the well prepared Lukas Hradecky (Bayer Leverkusen).

3' What a wasted opportunity by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Lukas Hradecky makes an astonishing save to thwart him. The ball is out of play. Stuttgart win a corner kick.
3' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
1' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
Stuttgart will kick-off.
